archetype: Modernized Frutiger Aero x Windows 7 UX x Deep Space Exploration
tagline: I build things I'm curious about.

design_philosophy.core_concept: What if a Windows 7-era Aero computer interface was redesigned as a futuristic orbital space station command desk?
design_philosophy.emotional_tone: Optimistic, exploratory, bright, tactile, intellectually curious, high-tech precise
anti_patterns_avoided: Literal Windows 7 start-menu clone / retro taskbar bloat
Generic flat dark cyberpunk neon slop (#7351B7)
Plain opaque card boxes with no depth

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-none
hierarchy.caption: text-xs font-mono tracking-widest uppercase text-cyan-400

surface_styles.aero_glass_panel: backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-900/60 border border-sky-400/25 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,180,216,0.12)] rounded-2xl relative overflow-hidden
surface_styles.aero_glass_button: relative px-5 py-2.5 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-b from-sky-400/30 to-blue-600/40 border border-sky-300/40 text-white font-medium shadow-[inset_0_1px_1px_rgba(255,255,255,0.6)] hover:brightness-125 transition-all duration-300 active:scale-95
surface_styles.orbital_badge: px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-mono bg-cyan-950/70 border border-cyan-500/40 text-cyan-300 flex items-center gap-1.5

key_sections.name: EXPERIMENT LAB
key_sections.description: Interactive sandboxes for live testing of creative coding prototypes (Pixelator workbench & 2D physics bottle).

key_sections.name: ROCKY AI (Project Hail Mary Companion)
key_sections.description: Interactive AI Assistant chatbot styled as an Aero Glass window with status 'ROCKY — ONLINE'. Expresses curiosity, enthusiasm, and uses phrases like 'AMAZE!'. Includes chip suggestions.

key_sections.name: VISUAL TRANSMISSIONS (Photography & Film)
key_sections.description: Stylistically distinct editorial showcase. Masonry lightbox gallery for photography (@hx.cr3) and film posters with video preview modal.

key_sections.name: SKILLS ORBIT
key_sections.description: Interactive tag cloud / constellation nodes (No boring progress bars!). Categories: Quantum & AI, Systems & Languages, Web & Creative Tech, Media Production.

key_sections.name: DEEP SPACE TRANSMITTER (Contact & Footer)
key_sections.description: Translucent Aero glass form for message sending with quick links and social badges.

accessibility_and_testing.reduced_motion: Wrap animations with Framer Motion condition or use fallback static views when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the Aero Glass + Deep Space aesthetic precisely: dark midnight backgrounds (#050914, #0B132B) with bright sky-blue & cyan translucent glass cards.
Implement the 3D Interactive Hero Canvas using R3F/Three.js with glossy metallic/glass materials, orbital rings, floating elements, and cursor movement interaction for Rocky.
Build live interactive demos inside the project cards: Animated QKD quantum channel diagram, live Pixelator canvas widget, and live 2D Water Bottle canvas physics sim.
Ensure Rocky AI Chat window is accessible both floating and inline, responding with enthusiastic persona ('AMAZE!', 'Fascinating human inquiry!').
Include case-study modal dialogs for each project detailing problem, architecture, research findings, and live demo links.
Include data-testid attributes on all key interactive elements for automated test verification.
